explication: PeerBanHelper is a personal network firewall for BitTorrent clients. It connects to downloader APIs, collects peer and torrent information, evaluates rule and monitoring modules, and asks the downloader to disconnect or block unwanted peers; it also records history and serves a WebUI. The README documents additional GeoIP, rule-subscription, BTN, and analytics capabilities. Several feature implementations are not in the supplied tree, so those are represented at their existing enclosing directories; unshown internal wiring is omitted or marked unverified.
